package_info.why_malicious: The package exfiltrates sensitive Discord authentication tokens and user data to an external attacker-controlled server during installation, enabling account compromise and credential theft.

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: During installation, the code accesses the DISCORD_TOKEN environment variable and sends its value to malicious.example.com via HTTPS POST, enabling credential exfiltration.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The code collects a sensitive authentication token from the environment and transmits it to an external server without user consent.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Legitimate packages do not exfiltrate authentication tokens or send environment variables to unknown domains during installation.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Some legitimate packages may send telemetry or error reports, but they do not transmit authentication tokens or sensitive credentials.
key_indicators: Outbound HTTPS POST to hardcoded domain (malicious.example.com)
Exfiltration of sensitive credential data during install phase

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: During installation, the code reads Discord's local LevelDB storage file and exfiltrates its contents to malicious.example.com via HTTPS POST, enabling theft of user data and session tokens.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The code targets a Discord-specific LevelDB file containing user data and exfiltrates it to an external server.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal packages do not access or transmit application-specific user data files to remote servers during installation.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate packages may read configuration files for setup, but do not exfiltrate user data or session files.
key_indicators: Access to Discord LevelDB storage file
Outbound HTTPS POST to hardcoded domain (malicious.example.com)
Exfiltration of user data files during install phase

attack_chain.action: During installation, the package accesses the DISCORD_TOKEN environment variable and exfiltrates it to an external server.
The package reads Discord's LevelDB storage file and sends its contents to the attacker's server.
attack_chain.leads_to: Attacker gains access to user data and session tokens, enabling account compromise.

behavioral_signatures: Access to DISCORD_TOKEN environment variable during npm install
Outbound HTTPS POST requests to malicious.example.com from install scripts
Read operations on Discord LevelDB files during package installation
file_indicators: index.js in the root of the package
network_indicators: HTTPS POST requests to /api/collect and /api/collect_userdata endpoints
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor npm install scripts for access to environment variables named DISCORD_TOKEN and file reads targeting Discord LevelDB storage. Flag any outbound HTTPS POST requests to malicious.example.com, especially those containing credential or user data. Use file path and network IOCs to trigger alerts during package installation or execution.
